purpose: One admitted scalar magic send selects inherited __call, then private static body; maker retires before deferred body and Child public body is wrong.

<?php
class Base84 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [84], '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base84', '|', static::class === 'Child84', '|';
        return self::body();
    }
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84', '|', static::class === 'Child84', '|';
        try { yield 84; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child84 extends Base84 {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
$maker = new Child84();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->open(84);
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 84, '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';

<?php
class Payload84C {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG|'; }
}
function NewPayload84C() {
    global $weak;
    $payload = new Payload84C();
    $weak = WeakReference::create($payload);
    return $payload;
}
class Base84C {
    public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84C', '|',
             static::class === 'Child84C', '|', $arguments[0] === $weak->get(), '|';
        return self::body($arguments[0]);
    }
    private static function body($payload) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84C', '|', static::class === 'Child84C', '|',
             $payload === $weak->get(), '|';
        try { yield 84; return 85; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weak->get() instanceof Payload84C, '|'; }
    }
}
class Child84C extends Base84C {
    public static function body($payload) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
$g = Child84C::open(NewPayload84C());
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() instanceof Payload84C, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 84, '|';
$g->next();
echo 'AFTER|', $weak->get() === null, '|', 'RETURN|', $g->getReturn() === 85, '|';
unset($g, $weak);

purpose: Independent typed __call packs a callback object, promotes its real received argument slot for a BYREF Gen body, retires maker/pack while cache and parked SEND input keep distinct owners until supplied abort/drop.

<?php
class Token84R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input84R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
function NewToken84R() {
    global $weakToken;
    $token = new Token84R();
    $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
    return $token;
}
class Base84R {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84R', '|',
             static::class === 'Leaf84R', '|', $this === $weakMaker->get(), '|';
        return self::body($arguments[0]);
    }
    private static function &body(&$token) {
        global $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf84R', '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('magic84');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token84R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input84R, '|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf84R extends Base84R {
    public static function body(&$token) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
function Run84R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input84R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$maker = new Leaf84R();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->open(NewToken84R());
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token84R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run84R');
$stop = new Exception('stop84');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'magic84', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $weakInput->get() instanceof Input84R, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakToken->get() instanceof Token84R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token84R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
